Publish changes

Edit products below — changes save automatically in this browser. When ready, download the updated storefront file and send it to Zeus in chat — he'll publish it live to your GitHub Pages store.

Prices, names, descriptions, Stripe links and download links can all be changed here. Product artwork stays the same. Turning a product inactive hides it from the storefront without deleting it. New products start inactive — add a Stripe payment link before activating.

Affiliate program

Give each partner a unique referral link (yourstore.com/?ref=CODE). When a sale comes from them, tag the order with their code under Orders — commissions calculate here automatically. Never share this admin URL — you manage affiliates here; they only get their link.

How it works (manual but real): ① Add an affiliate below → ② send them their referral link → ③ when they bring a sale, set the order's affiliate code → ④ commission owed appears here → ⑤ pay them (Cash App, PayPal, etc.) and mark it paid.

Security

Plain truth: this dashboard is hosted on a public page. The login email and password live inside the page's code — anyone who finds this URL can read them from the page source. Treat the login as a privacy screen, not a lock. The good news: your business data (orders, customers, affiliates) is stored only in this browser on your device — it is never uploaded anywhere, so a stranger opening this page sees an empty dashboard, not your data.
Want a real lock? That needs a server checking the password (free options exist). Say the word and we'll set that up — until then, don't reuse this password anywhere important.

Change password (this device only)

Changing it here updates this browser only. Other devices keep the old password until the dashboard file itself is republished.
